authority: Direct user request for periodic Astra assessment and faster performance iteration

early_triggers.repeated_avoidable_harness_failures: early review; failures do not count as performance rounds

round_definition: One completed discriminating paired optimization experiment or causal diagnostic; all arms in one matrix count once. Polls, manifests, repeated builds and no-new-information checks do not count.
review_output_required: whole Model/service gains vs component/engineering only
iteration time breakdown and avoidable waiting
current workload profile and wall critical path
at most2 executable experiment cards per model
reuse evidence and minimal necessary checks
root_actions_required: assign concrete files/resources/configuration/exit conditions to original owners
next review verify implementation/result instead of repeating proposal
